text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim and closing restatement","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"The essay keeps a direct, consistent position on driverless cars and returns to that position in the conclusion."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on driving enjoyment, safety, and liability","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups its reasons into separate sections that make the line of reasoning easier to follow."},{"evidence":"\"if every person in the United States were that way\"","quality":"development","description":"The essay develops its claims by explaining consequences and extending them into broader scenarios."},{"evidence":"reference to train travel and manual control","quality":"comparison use","description":"The essay uses analogies and comparisons to clarify why the writer opposes driverless cars."},{"evidence":"\"Who is laible for an accident...\" and roadwork discussion","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"The essay shows awareness of practical objections and unresolved problems, especially liability and changing road conditions."}]}
